scope: Relevant optimization classes identified in this review, not a mathematical exhaustive enumeration. Not all candidates are authorized for implementation.

candidates.title: Singleton-array longwave typed fast path
candidates.transformation: Add U-profile retaining singleton arithmetic during coefficient preparation, then consume verified scalar values in a matching compiled typed DAG. Do not change the public material function.
candidates.proof_and_guard: size==1 is an admission clue, not permission for early .item(); trace every broadcast/promotion and allow different sun/shade dtypes.
candidates.cost_model: Remove fallback dispatch and O(Td*P) full-raster Python expressions; remaining ordered work O(Td*N*P).
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: 64/128-square landcover and no-landcover 24/48-step actual traces; count scalar/singleton/field fallback and compare every radiation/state boundary.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Array rank or compiler math makes parity fail; keep retained reference for unproven profiles.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Foundational coverage improvement; do not double-count disappearance of _operate inside this same fallback.

candidates.title: Prepare a small typed execution plan
candidates.transformation: Resolve scalar/array promotion and input capabilities once per invocation/timestep; use a small reviewed family of kernels rather than a general compiler project.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Static profile facts remain stable; dynamic values, ownership and errors stay at required checkpoints.
candidates.cost_model: O(number_of_profiles) compilation and O(T) planning replace repeated Python type checks.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Record typed nodes for real captures; compare profile signatures and intermediate bits against original helpers.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Plan creation, specializations or cold JIT dominate savings.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: T01 first; no independent speedup multiplier for type checks already removed by T01.

candidates.title: Exact finite-mask contribution tables
candidates.transformation: Evaluate original ordered contribution separately for each used Boolean mask state per patch and time. Retain contribution dtype until the original accumulator addition.
candidates.proof_and_guard: No pre-summing terms; unused states must not introduce warnings; preserve zero multiplication, mixed sun/shade precision and original patch order.
candidates.cost_model: Expression evaluation NP -> C*P per timestep, with NP lookups/additions remaining; win if c_lookup<c_expression.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Compare every contribution and prefix for actual U/S profiles, signed zero and guarded nonfinite paths; time table preparation too.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Lookup traffic or branch pressure exceeds eliminated arithmetic; table state count approaches N.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Evaluate after T01; two-table and one-table variants only.

candidates.title: Compute true field radiance once per timestep
candidates.transformation: For genuinely varying wall inputs, retain array coefficient preparation once, then feed field values to an ordered compiled kernel.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Keep full rank/broadcast contract, ndarray promotion and alias/mutation epoch; no assumed uniformity.
candidates.cost_model: P repeated surface expression evaluations -> one evaluation plus NP loads.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Small nonuniform field cases admitted by original low-level API; compare full diagnostics separately.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Real production never uses field profile or implementation cost cannot repay observed coverage.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Not needed to fix the standard singleton case; T01 does not depend on this.

candidates.title: Exact ASVF equivalence classes
candidates.transformation: Group exact ASVF bit patterns plus every relevant input/profile and classify unique values; scatter results without quantization.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Byte identity including sign and profile; hash collisions resolved by content; reject semantic changes in fallback.
candidates.cost_model: Expensive evaluations NP -> UP, but scatter still NP; U is unique-state count.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Measure U/N, grouping cost and scatter on actual landcover scenes before writing kernel.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: U near N, class construction cost or poor scatter locality.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Separate from coefficient-table path already shipped.

candidates.title: Reuse exact classification across consumers
candidates.transformation: Share sun/shade masks between shortwave and longwave only when actual patch order, ASVF, angles, active mask and math profile are identical.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Full-key equality; different active masks may use a proven common superset but must preserve error behavior.
candidates.cost_model: One classification rather than two, at extra bounded lifetime/space.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Capture full keys from both real consumers; count exact overlaps and live bytes.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Different tables or stage lifetime make reuse impossible or memory-heavy.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: May overlap T07/R04; no NP-wide persistent mask history.

candidates.title: Precompute exact tan32(ASVF)
candidates.transformation: Retain one immutable field of the original tan32 result for geometry lifetime or reuse block-local values.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Same input layout-sensitive math profile and guards; key includes exact ASVF bytes and implementation; do not replace atan.
candidates.cost_model: One N-element field (~4N bytes) versus repeated block tan calls across P/T consumers.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Compare exact tan output at vector tails, strides and fallback domains; include preparation/memory.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Already cached in selected path, cache cost not amortized or profile-dependent layout changes output.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Avoid counting as new if current code already reuses it in a particular route.

candidates.title: Extend private demand projection across fallback
candidates.transformation: Keep only live primary accumulators in a new typed fallback replacement; full public diagnostic API remains complete.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Backward liveness includes late additions, state, errors and requested traces. Omitted values are NOT_REQUESTED, not fabricated arrays.
candidates.cost_model: Remove diagnostic-only arithmetic and writes; primary two-pass recurrence unchanged.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Demand-on/off with full reference returned fields; compare TMRT and carried state.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Value assumed diagnostic influences later state or errors.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Existing scalar primary reduction already does this; new only for currently uncompiled profiles.

candidates.title: Uniform-value representation by provenance
candidates.transformation: Represent known uniform forcing/material data as (value, typed-origin) and materialize only for consumers/output requiring arrays.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Uniformity from immutable construction or exact validation; preserve plus-zero and add-order semantics.
candidates.cost_model: Avoid N-size preparation/loads and temp arrays; O(N) outputs still necessary when requested.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Temperature and speed construction with signed zero/UHI values, output flags and mixed-dtype profiles.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Uniformity check costs more than reuse or shape is observable through public return.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: T01 applies rank-aware mechanism to a specific high-value case.

candidates.title: Low-entropy field category coefficient evaluation
candidates.transformation: Use exact material/forcing state tuples to prepare per-category expressions once; retain gather by material label.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Current material map performs value-based successive replacement, not always clean ID lookup; reproduce its actual result before reindexing.
candidates.cost_model: NF expensive evaluations -> UF+N gather, U=unique tuples.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Small crafted classes with output values equal to later class IDs; exact final mapped arrays.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Unsafe alias/value-replacement behavior or few repetitions.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Do not silently fix inherited landcover mapping quirks.

candidates.title: Longwave consumer-specific predicate cache
candidates.transformation: Derive sky/veg/wall/reflection four predicates once from original three channels; store up to four bits per pixel-patch for the LW consumer only.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Compute original typed predicates including (1-sh)*vb; preserve original visibility/raw export. New early warnings must not appear.
candidates.cost_model: Prepare C0; reuse if T*(decode3+predicate-code_read)>C0. Packed derived size NP/2 bytes.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: All binary/ternary/raw profiles, odd shapes, sign/nonfinite guards, cache corruption and 24-step amortization.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Additional 76.5 MiB at 1024 square is not amortized, raw guard expensive or classification dominates.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Not a claim of a 32x overall traffic reduction. Alternative to repeated decode, not multiplicative with R05.

candidates.title: Proven inactive-contribution skipping
candidates.transformation: Skip contributions only after proving they are bitwise no-ops for each accumulator and cannot cause warnings.
candidates.proof_and_guard: 0*Inf and negative zero are counterexamples; zero masks alone insufficient. Keep exact replay otherwise.
candidates.cost_model: Visit active contributions plus guard cost rather than every possible update.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Small exhaustive accumulator/sign cases and domain certificates; measure active fraction.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Proof excludes most workload or masked branch divergence outweighs skipped arithmetic.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Strictly harder than predicate caching; never implied by R01.

candidates.title: Ordered aniLum block kernel
candidates.transformation: Compile the separate diffuse patch sweep with block-owned accumulator, original patch order and typed multiply/add.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Preserve LazyDiffVisibility arithmetic, channel read order, raw values and float addition.
candidates.cost_model: O(NP) stays, Python P full-raster dispatch/materialization removed.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Real dRad/aniLum traces before Kdown and shortwave; 64-256 square warm stage time.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Stage fraction too small, new decode loses or error checkpoints differ.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Independent small implementation; do not wait for native research.

candidates.title: Share diffuse decode with shortwave at a legal boundary
candidates.transformation: Move or join aniLum consumption only after proving dRad is not needed before the joint region; otherwise bounded shared decode cache.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Full use-def order; no change to shadows, temperature preparation or Kdown chronology.
candidates.cost_model: Eliminate duplicate visibility read/decode; store only needed bounded fields.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Exact execution trace of reads/writes plus old/new stage outputs.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Consumer lifetime requires a full cube or would move an observable computation.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: R03 is safe independent fallback; this is not automatic fusion.

candidates.title: Direct predicate/visibility consumption in microtiles
candidates.transformation: Consume packed data in cache-sized pixel groups using original arithmetic, not a full-scene AoSoA conversion.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Per-pixel patch order and byte-error order intact; code is new only if it differs from failed fused designs.
candidates.cost_model: Scratch O(BP) -> O(BA)+small patch slices, plus decode arithmetic; choose via actual traffic.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Compare current N9 stream, same schedule Numba, changed producer and combined region.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Repeated per-lane bit extraction or register pressure recreates P01 regression.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Do not enable old rejected env switches as the implementation.

candidates.title: Reusable scratch with explicit generation ownership
candidates.transformation: Allocate bounded slots per worker/profile and initialize exactly the active ranges before reuse across calls.
candidates.proof_and_guard: No stale inactive masks/tail lanes, aliasing, open owner or exception leakage; no buffer reuse before consumer completion.
candidates.cost_model: Reduce repeated allocations/zeros at cost of stable live space.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Changing active patches, alternating shapes, poisoned padding, cancellation and repeated scenes.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Saved allocation is negligible or retained cache bloats resident memory.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Existing per-call slots already exist; target cross-call and unnecessary initialization only.

candidates.title: Coarse dispatch with small microblocks
candidates.transformation: Separate public block size, cache microblock and native dispatch region; move loops across Python boundary when all operations are compiled.
candidates.proof_and_guard: No callback per microblock in a purported coarse kernel; enforce exact read/error and output order.
candidates.cost_model: Calls K*T*N/B -> K*T*N/M, M>=B; scratch stays O(BP), not O(MP).
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Count actual calls, stage time and scratch; small/large/tail blocks and caller-requested block controls.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Dispatch savings already achieved by N9 or required callbacks remain.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Combined savings with R06 are measured together; not multiplied.

candidates.title: Compiler/layout tuning under current backend first
candidates.transformation: Inspect assembly/IR for gaps; compare lane width, unroll, coefficient hoists and locality with original ordering in Numba.
candidates.proof_and_guard: No FMA/contraction/reassociation; SIMD across outputs only.
candidates.cost_model: Gain depends on baseline SIMD efficiency, gather latency and occupancy, not vector width alone.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Two bounded variants, one actual profile; assembly and wrapper measurements.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: No material residual or near-parity complexity makes maintenance unjustified.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Native alternative only after this strongest B exists.

candidates.title: Exact repeated signature and prefix sharing
candidates.transformation: Memoize identical complete typed computations or identical ordered prefixes with the SAME entering accumulator.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Visibility equality alone insufficient: include Lup, material, ASVF, coeffs, order and initial state.
candidates.cost_model: UP or trie-prefix work replaces repeated NP, with hashing/gather/scatter overhead.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Only census exact duplicate rate first; then tiny verified prototype if high.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: U near N or index overhead dominates.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Not low rank, quantization or approximate lookup.

candidates.title: Remove unused private patch tables and copies
candidates.transformation: Audit unused Lsky_normal/cardinal setup and temporary table copies inside primary demand only.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Full public diagnostic return preserved; warning/mutation/liveness analysis before removal.
candidates.cost_model: O(P) setup and some allocations removed; small expected coverage.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Complete private-vs-full projection tests and allocation counts.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: No significant measured cost; do not distract from T01.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Already-shipped diagnostic elimination is baseline, not new credit.

candidates.title: Prepared GVF at one thread
candidates.transformation: Decouple invariant source preparation and bounded postprocessing from the threads>1 route gate. Use serial compiled gather when H=1.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Preserve guard union, first/later water snapshot, dtype and mutation timing, alias fallbacks.
candidates.cost_model: Same gather work with less repeated preparation/allocation; useful for W workers at H=1.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: H1/H2 default calls with/without landcover, water and aliases; compare every GVF field.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Serial prepared path is slower on protected cells or changes errors.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Not a blanket increase of CPU budget.

candidates.title: Ground contribution prefix before first blocker
candidates.transformation: Precompute static first blockage index and stop ground contribution loads after f becomes zero; retain all wall-state updates or exact substitutes.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Finite-safe absorption proof against actual bounds and previous-sample edge retention; zero multiplication not harmless with Inf.
candidates.cost_model: T*N*D*R -> prepare+T*N*D*(mean_prefix+overhead).
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Dense/open/water adversarial rays and all 16 original intermediates.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Open scenes have no short prefix; guard/precompute cannot repay.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Conditional companion to G03, not naive break at building.

candidates.title: Exact repeated-addition tables for wall contributions
candidates.transformation: Store A_c(0)=+0; A_c(n+1)=RN(A_c(n)+c), then use exact count of repeated activated contributions.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Never n*c; c dtype and initial signed-zero accumulator fixed, count reproduces actual step order.
candidates.cost_model: O(U*R) table prep versus repeated constant addition per receiver/direction.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Counts at first/second search boundaries, c signs, overflow guards and mutation profiles.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: c varies per pixel so U large, or random table lookup loses.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Enables legal wall continuation after G02; cannot remove all post-blocker work without proof.

candidates.title: Cache static unshadowed albedo subfields
candidates.transformation: Factor only fields dependent on immutable geometry/albedo, not changing radiance or shadows.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Trace full dependencies and validity key; ordered total/cardinal sums unchanged.
candidates.cost_model: T*Cs -> Cs+T*read; need T*(Cs-read)>build.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Small multi-day, changed-albedo and changed-shadow tests; setup+memory included.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Static fraction tiny or extra five maps cost more than saved work.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Never cache the full ground-view radiance.

candidates.title: Fuse remaining gather and postprocess storage
candidates.transformation: Use exact typed receiver accumulators through immediate postprocess before storing outputs; inspect current compiled postprocess before redesign.
candidates.proof_and_guard: 16 intermediates remain observable in diagnostic route; direction order and keep-mask moment preserved.
candidates.cost_model: Avoid intermediate write/read traffic; arithmetic unchanged.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Trace all intermediates in diagnostic build and compare final fields; inspect spills.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Already fused in selected route or oversized kernel spills.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: G03/current typed postprocess already shipped; only missing boundaries count.

candidates.title: Reuse exact addressing and direction constants
candidates.transformation: Reuse verified schedule and angle constants across directions/timesteps within exact scale/shape/profile keys.
candidates.proof_and_guard: No giant ND*R address table; source boundary history and scalar rounding preserved.
candidates.cost_model: Prepare once vs repeated setup; bounded descriptors.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Pointer identity/call-count census, varied scale, original rounding boundaries.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Current cache already covers work or descriptors dominate memory.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Catalogued to prevent rebuilding an existing schedule cache.

candidates.title: Pointwise thermal-state fusion without time scan
candidates.transformation: Fuse updates of independent carried maps at one chronological step, keeping old source versions alive through all reads.
candidates.proof_and_guard: No independent timesteps, no closed-form recurrence; snapshot aliases and original rounding/order.
candidates.cost_model: Fewer raster temporaries/pass crossings for five directional maps.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: State after every 24/48 step including firstdaytime, night and restart.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: State updates differ by dtype/branch or dominate little time.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Separate from GVF physics and persists same complete state.

candidates.title: Use existing exact wall-shadow parallel paths selectively
candidates.transformation: Dispatch exact_13/exact_23 under measured within-tile budget rather than hardcoded serial on all compatible calls.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Both wall shadow families and outputs; process-level thread masks; no nested pools.
candidates.cost_model: Same work, shorter span until bandwidth/divergence saturation.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: H1/H2/H4 actual route counters and branch-safe small scene parity.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Little scaling or phase overhead exceeds gain.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Do not attribute it to source compilation; kernels already exist.

candidates.title: Separate static global bush control sequence
candidates.transformation: Precompute per-step global activation from immutable shifted canopy and bush, then run a verified pixel recurrence using the control sequence.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Global NaN poisoning and first-step behavior must match; sparse-any shortcut only for proven finite domain.
candidates.cost_model: Control O(LN) may become O(LNb); reduced barriers but pixel shadow work remains.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Positive-bush actual fixtures, all-negative and nonfinite edge tests, full three masks.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Bush path rare or global control prep more expensive.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Absorption shortcut for no-bush is already shipped; this is different.

candidates.title: Certified ray suffix pruning
candidates.transformation: Use suffix minima of stored decrements plus conservative height maxima to prove all remaining samples ineffective.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Include zero padding, first-step correction and every output; wall quantities need separate proof.
candidates.cost_model: Saved sample visits minus bound/search setup; no absolute-height normalization.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Count provably removable suffix before implementing; low sun, negative terrain, disordered decrements.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Few certifiable suffixes or invalid proof on vegetation/wall state.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Shares saved samples with existing absorption; combine as a union, not product.

candidates.title: Hierarchy skipping on the actual discrete sample set
candidates.transformation: Use flat conservative region bounds only where all exact scheduled sample updates can be proved irrelevant.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Do not replace oblique discrete rays with a continuous horizon recurrence.
candidates.cost_model: Build+bound queries+visited exact samples; upper-bounded improvement by truly pruned fraction.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Small compiled prototype only after counters justify; compare original coordinates verbatim.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Old Python hierarchy regression repeats or construction cannot amortize.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Known rejected horizons/hierarchies are controls, not candidate implementations.

candidates.title: SVF annulus accumulation fusion
candidates.transformation: Accumulate all required SVF fields with original per-annulus multiply/add rounding, avoiding transient full planes.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Keep each annulus weight and addition sequence; no sum-weights-first substitution.
candidates.cost_model: Same scalar arithmetic, fewer whole-raster passes.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Compare all SVF fields, masks and exports at all supported patch options.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Already optimized sufficiently or compiler/profile mismatch.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Patch count and correction/clipping rules unchanged.

candidates.title: Residual wall/aspect scheduling and filter reuse
candidates.transformation: Inspect remaining setup and parallel scheduling; reuse sparse rotated filters already present, specialize only residual bottleneck.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Tie order, interpolation, border exclusions, signed zeros and masks unchanged.
candidates.cost_model: Only remaining setup/loop overhead removable; existing wall speedups are not new.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Small scenes with ties/rotations and one geometry-cold medium case.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Wall time is negligible relative to campaign budget.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Do not implement Sobel or approximate aspect as optimization.

candidates.title: Exact ray schedule reuse across identical calls
candidates.transformation: Cache immutable generated bounds/decrements when all source-relevant shape, dtype, scale, angles and termination limits match exactly.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Same source range shape and slicing semantics, no approximate angle bins.
candidates.cost_model: O(L) setup once per exact key; bounded byte LRU.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Exact repeated and nextafter angle values, negative zero, different amaxvalue.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Schedules unique or hashing all dynamic arrays costs more than generation.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Most useful repeated scenarios; not a claim all solar schedules repeat.

candidates.title: Receiver packet grouping for divergence
candidates.transformation: Group independent receivers by proven workload descriptors or compact active lanes while retaining each ray sequence.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Only receiver scheduling changes; output scatter and error ordering protected.
candidates.cost_model: Lane efficiency eta=sum(L)/(w*max(L)); include grouping/scatter costs.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Actual packet-length distribution first, then exact receiver-order comparisons.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Gather locality or scheduling destroys saved lane efficiency.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Wide SIMD alone is not speedup evidence.

candidates.title: UTCI input/output pointwise fusion
candidates.transformation: Fuse accepted polynomial with exact wind/temperature preparation and output masking where liveness permits.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Same coefficients, powers, operation ordering, vapor math and final mask; no Horner reordering.
candidates.cost_model: O(NT) remains; reduce raster writes and reads.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Known polynomial fixtures, adverse weather, masked receivers and output plans.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Comfort fraction small or compiler instructions regress.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Uniform vapor preparation is already shipped.

candidates.title: Avoid unnecessary uniform Ta and Tmrt copy planes
candidates.transformation: Compute the exact scalar zero-plus-temperature-plus-UHI expression once for UTCI; materialize only when a field consumer/writer needs it.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Preserve +0/-0, two rounding steps, WBGT needs and public outputs; assigning Tmrt directly needs alias proof.
candidates.cost_model: Several 4N-byte allocation/read/write passes per step avoided.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Signed zero, UHI edge values, with/without Ta and WBGT outputs; writer ownership.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Required outputs force same work or alias safety needs copy.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Not equivalent to deleting output flags.

candidates.title: Wet-bulb solver work reuse/compilation
candidates.transformation: Compile actual iterative kernel or reuse exact repeated forcing inputs, preserving global stop behavior.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Array-wide convergence vs per-element convergence are NOT interchangeable; limits/phase unchanged.
candidates.cost_model: Fewer dispatches or repeated identical iterations, conditional on real solver cost.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Near convergence thresholds, extreme humidity, same iteration trace.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: WBGT not requested or solver setup tiny.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: No substitute thermal-comfort library.

candidates.title: Black-globe/WBGT postprocess fusion
candidates.transformation: Fuse hcg, globe and original shade expression in one pointwise stage retaining dtype.
candidates.proof_and_guard: np.where eagerly evaluates both expressions; warnings and shade selection stay exact.
candidates.cost_model: Reduce full-plane intermediates; no change in physical expression.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Shadow .1 threshold nextafter, mixed field dtype and output metadata.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: WBGT has low usage/coverage.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Separate from wet-bulb solver.

candidates.title: Exact wind forcing reuse
candidates.transformation: Reuse repeated direction/speed products keyed by original coefficient bytes and exact meteorology bits when frequent.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Preserve 15-degree tie rounding, missing-direction errors and .15 floor; bounded LRU only.
candidates.cost_model: Repeated N multiplications removed when K_unique << T.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Directional ties, invalid met directions, changed file contents and repeated speeds.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Every step unique or caching full speed fields increases pressure.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: S04 is memory/loading, this is dynamic arithmetic reuse.

candidates.title: Optional forcing/acquisition preprocessing
candidates.transformation: Profile ERA5/WRF/wind-building separately; reuse exact spatial interpolation weights and immutable acquired inputs, batch authorized independent requests.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Same interpolation/aggregation/timezone units and error behavior; no production credentials or new paid calls without authorization.
candidates.cost_model: Eliminate repeated setup/remote bytes; core TIFF comparisons exclude network acquisition transparently.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Local recorded fixture and labeled service mocks; real service validation separately.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: No active optional workload; do not install all extras for core optimization.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Not a source-audited new speed claim; local full implementation audit required.

candidates.title: Effective thread accounting and one parallel owner
candidates.transformation: Record actual Numba pool/mask and nested native counts inside the real worker. Separate slot count from leaf threads.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Do not assert thread_budget=1 means one CPU core; explicit parallel=False must stay serial.
candidates.cost_model: Remove oversubscription or underuse, not arithmetic; budgets matched across arms.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Fresh process H1/H2/H4, direct/private/public routes, CPU-time evidence.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: No scope for improvement after actual resource census.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Required before all scaling claims.

candidates.title: Joint worker/thread/microblock selection
candidates.transformation: Choose a small measured W,H,B portfolio within unchanged total budget; stage-specific settings if justified.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Logical tile count/extent unchanged; preserve caller controls and per-process limits.
candidates.cost_model: Throughput approximately W/(s+p/H), limited by bandwidth/RAM.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: 1x4 vs 2x2; 4x1 only after G01, actual admitted counts.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Memory pressure or available cells are insufficient; no blind use-all-cores default.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Do not multiply with same-core kernel parallel speedup.

candidates.title: Memory inventory from live encoded data
candidates.transformation: Reserve actual verified encoding payload, carried maps, simultaneous workspace, child native/GDAL caches and writer slots.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Cold unknown remains worst-case or hard bounded streaming; no safety bypass based on observed RSS alone.
candidates.cost_model: Capacity can permit more active jobs; memory is a constraint, not a speed multiplier.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Known binary/mixed/raw fixtures and concurrent peak samples, allocation ledger and OOM fail-closed.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Worst-case paths are not accounted or safety margin unverifiable.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Existing phase admission is baseline; complete actual mode/lifetime pricing only.

candidates.title: Bounded/lazy directional wind loading
candidates.transformation: Keep mandatory inventory/shape checks and content guards, but load/map a bounded set of used direction planes.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Unused corrupt rasters currently may error during eager read; preserve that validation checkpoint even if it limits I/O savings.
candidates.cost_model: Reduce up to 12 full resident planes; I/O reduction only if same error policy is retained.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Unused corrupt/wrong-shape direction and met tie fixtures; descriptor lifetime/restart.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Equivalent eager validation consumes all bandwidth or cache misses dominate.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Do not claim deferred validation is transparent.

candidates.title: Fuse fingerprints with required reads
candidates.transformation: Hash bytes while an existing required traversal reads the SAME stored byte stream, and reuse result only inside a frozen snapshot epoch.
candidates.proof_and_guard: A raster-value digest is not a file-content digest; preserve every external-change detection checkpoint. mtime/size not equivalent.
candidates.cost_model: Eliminate duplicated reads within a checkpoint, not all InputGuard checks.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Same-size/mtime modifications, mutation during reads, cache handoff and publication.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Storage snapshots/ownership do not support reuse; keep original guards.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Implementation code hashes and input checks have distinct scopes.

candidates.title: Implementation identity manifest with complete dependency closure
candidates.transformation: Cache immutable installed source identity once per invocation and explicitly include changed _native_dispatch/profile sources in new execution identity.
candidates.proof_and_guard: No underspecified cache key. Keep input guards separate; new identity version may force safe recomputation.
candidates.cost_model: Reduce repeated source reads; prevent stale cache evidence after profile changes.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Edit one imported helper and verify invalidation; installed read-only vs mutable checkout cases.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Source mutation semantics cannot be preserved by caching.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Correctness prerequisite, not necessarily speedup; identities.py currently enumerates only selected folders.

candidates.title: Single stored-stream export validation
candidates.transformation: Combine CRC/schema and actual value checks during one bounded traversal of stored NPZ/TIFF data; remove import/reencode/decode loops.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Check all bytes, members, metadata, raw bits, trailing data and original error priority; retained validator on ambiguous failure if needed.
candidates.cost_model: Reduce repeated decompress/parse/encode/read traversals, include scratch and full verification.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Small valid/corrupt archives, duplicates, late CRC failure, signed-zero TIFF, interrupted publish.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Cannot preserve error/CRC contract or export stage too small.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: No deleting verification; no new export schema required.

candidates.title: Parallel preparation, ordered artifact publication
candidates.transformation: Run independent export/verification jobs in bounded private staging, then publish in required tile order.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Same destination ownership, failure order, backup rollback, commit barriers; cancellation must drain owners.
candidates.cost_model: Stage time ~ceil(K/W)*prepare + K*serial_publish, not whole-stage /W.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: 2-4 small distinct tiles, fail late/early, lock collisions and full artifacts.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Disk/CPU compression saturation or ordering costs erase benefit.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Geometry numerical parallel phase already exists.

candidates.title: Streaming checkpoint serialization
candidates.transformation: Replace BytesIO payload duplication with a bounded hashing writer producing exactly the required NPY bytes, then flush/fsync as before.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Preserve array/scalar tags, endianness, Fortran order, header version, hashes, file names and error cleanup.
candidates.cost_model: Avoid peak serialized array copy and getvalue duplication; write volume unchanged.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Byte-for-byte checkpoint comparison, noncontiguous arrays, scalar signed zero and crash injection.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: np.save interaction requires seeks or hash stream differs; use verified helper/fallback.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Already hashes serialized bytes, so do not claim eliminating a nonexistent file re-read.

candidates.title: Reuse identical durable checkpoint payloads
candidates.transformation: Reference exact unchanged immutable payload generations or duplicate via safe link while preserving cursor commit.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Same corruption checks and old-state resume; fsync, refcount/GC and failure cleanup proven. Private versioning if needed.
candidates.cost_model: M+(T-1)*changed_fraction*M bytes vs T*M, plus hash/comparison read costs.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Repeated states, corrupt previously stored payload, interrupted link/publication and deletion.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Arrays change every step or identity verification costs dominate.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: No checkpoint interval reduction; design-only until compatibility proof.

candidates.title: Bounded output overlap
candidates.transformation: One writer owner consumes immutable snapshots while computation prepares independent work; bounded double buffers with completion acknowledgement.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Checkpoint cannot advance until required output durability; stop and propagate writer errors before dependent publication.
candidates.cost_model: Potential steady-state max(compute,IO) instead of sum, only for actually overlap-safe region.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Slow writer, injected error, two timesteps, cancellation and buffer poisoning.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Per-step durability barrier prevents useful overlap or extra copy costs win.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Device download overlap accounted in H04, not counted twice.

candidates.title: Validated preprocessing artifact reuse
candidates.transformation: Avoid rewriting identical translated tiles only when existing contents, metadata and required side effects are fully preserved.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Original clear-folder/overwrite and stale file semantics remain; no hardlink mutable input as private output.
candidates.cost_model: Read/validate vs translate/write cost; win only with sufficient repetition.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Changed affine/CRS/extent, partial folder, same data different compression and overwrite cases.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Public preprocess must rebuild by contract; leave as separate explicit reuse mode.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Not an excuse to compare cold baseline against warm candidate.

candidates.title: Align GDAL reservations with enforced actual cache caps
candidates.transformation: Use measured/probed effective per-process GDAL cache and explicit controlled caps consistently in admission and execution.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Honor caller policy; restore process/global settings; no hidden global mutation or budget relaxation.
candidates.cost_model: May reduce conservative over-reservation and actual cache pressure, not guaranteed runtime speed.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Child GetCacheMax value, env/user caps, several processes and protected no-env behavior.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Application cannot safely scope cap or OS effects dominate.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Current planner uses physical-memory 5% default; do not merely alter estimator.

candidates.title: Reusable worker-static preparation and bounded JIT cache
candidates.transformation: Reuse expensive immutable helpers such as timezone index, import/metadata tables and compiled artifacts across independent tiles.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Location-specific solar/forcing outputs remain keyed by exact coordinates/time; cache dirs require approved write-location policy.
candidates.cost_model: Amortize imports/setup J/K; bound retained memory and stale code invalidation.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Two different locations/dates/epochs in same worker, read-only install, no toolchain, cache miss/hit.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Helper mutable/not thread-safe or process lifetime memory grows.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Persistent worker pool already shipped; reuse inside it is the residual.

candidates.title: Remove unsafe global demand coupling before thread fanout
candidates.transformation: Use explicit private context or scoped ContextVar where independent tiles could share a process; otherwise keep process isolation.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Public demand APIs and restoration after exceptions unchanged; no race between tile contexts.
candidates.cost_model: Enabler for future safe scheduling, not standalone promised gain.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Interleaved demand modes and exceptions, two threads, restoration assertion.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Only process-isolated execution needed; avoid gratuitous refactor.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Do not launch tile threads over process-global demand state.

candidates.title: Bounded mmap/descriptor and file-handle reuse
candidates.transformation: Retain validated owner-bound handles across related stages while closing after last reader; LRU by bytes/descriptors.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Immutable content checks, close locks, inode replacement and descriptor budget honored.
candidates.cost_model: Avoid repeated map/open/setup; page faults and resident pages still counted.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Concurrent close, file replacement, repeated tiles, descriptor exhaustion.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Long-lived maps inflate memory or undermine mutation checks.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Not equivalent to zero memory usage.

candidates.title: Demand-driven terminal computation and outputs
candidates.transformation: Derive backward liveness from actual requested artifacts, public returns, state, warnings and neighbor reads.
candidates.proof_and_guard: UTCI is a required pipeline output despite no obvious save_utci flag; inspect OutputPlan before pruning.
candidates.cost_model: Remove only truly unobserved computation; bytes of required output remain.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: All save flags, diagnostics, WBGT, traces and resume output plans.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Any alleged dead result is consumed by TMRT/state or error semantics.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Different output plans compared separately, never hidden workload reduction.

candidates.title: Allocator/GC and import overhead investigation
candidates.transformation: Measure GC/allocation/import time before considering buffer pools, delayed imports or temporary GC policies.
candidates.proof_and_guard: No blanket disable, unbounded object cache, leaked handles or global process surprise.
candidates.cost_model: Only measured fraction removable.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Allocation counters and repeated tile RSS slope, then one small controlled change.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: No meaningful evidence; defer rather than tune folklore.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Numba new JIT signatures may be root cause, not GC.

candidates.title: Select whole CPU/GPU residency regions
candidates.transformation: Compare retaining geometry/predicate/state on device across multiple consumers/timesteps against best current CPU, with all boundaries.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Chronology, output/checkpoint and dtype exact profile unchanged; CPU remains complete fallback.
candidates.cost_model: Tgpu=setup+H2D+launch+kernel+D2H+sync+remaining; select regions, not fastest individual functions.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Small real region, explicit device and synchronized timing plus bytes; at most one backend first.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: No GPU hardware or break-even impossible; record unavailable, do not emulate speed.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Architecture study is broad; native-default N9 remains closed.

candidates.title: Device-side compact decode and ordered accumulation
candidates.transformation: GPU work item owns an output; tile packed inputs, decode and consume without giant NP materialization.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Original patch reduction order, two passes and raw fallback. No warp/tree sum silently.
candidates.cost_model: Trade cheap integer work for less global traffic; report register/local-memory spills.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: CPU reference vs exact device intermediate states; measure decode+kernel+transfer.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Divergence, FP64 or decoder pressure negates bandwidth savings.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: FlashAttention-style I/O reasoning, not borrowing its numeric guarantees or speed ratios.

candidates.title: Keep sensitive scalar/profile math on CPU
candidates.transformation: Upload trusted coefficient tables and classify on CPU initially, device runs bulk arithmetic only.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Do not narrow float64 contributions before float64 add then float32 store. Device capability required for profile.
candidates.cost_model: Small per-step coefficients vs large resident receiver state; conversion overhead included.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Actual mixed sun/shade types and nonfinite predicates, fully synchronized output.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Required FP64 unavailable/slow or coefficient masks themselves require huge transfers.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: MLX GPU float64 unsupported per inspected docs; backend probe must fail closed.

candidates.title: Bounded transfer/compute pipeline
candidates.transformation: Overlap independent upload/compute/download slots with explicit events and one writer.
candidates.proof_and_guard: No time dependence violation, early checkpoint, mutable buffer reuse or hidden async errors.
candidates.cost_model: Throughput approaches max(link,compute,writer) only if independently overlap-safe.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Counter/accounting trace, saturation and failure/cancel tests.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Unified bandwidth bottleneck or extra copies exceed overlap.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Do not double-count S11 writer overlap.

candidates.title: Unified-memory and out-of-core device scheduling
candidates.transformation: Treat host/device unified pages as shared capacity; bounded resident regions with explicit completion and pressure reserve.
candidates.proof_and_guard: No assumption zero-copy means no synchronization, allocation or page traffic.
candidates.cost_model: Resident static+state+scratch+queues below safe capacity; bandwidth shared with CPU.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Peak memory/pressure and transfer counters on actual hardware only.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Paging, eviction or concurrent CPU access dominates.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: No swap-based speedup strategy.

candidates.title: New native/portable compiler only after causal coverage evidence
candidates.transformation: Compare Numba B with equivalent-layout ISPC/Highway/Dr.Jit/PoCL only if a broad residual region and new design are established.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Keep N9 decisions historical; no automatic reactivation of old env switches, runtime build or user setup.
candidates.cost_model: Application gain via Amdahl including producer/packing/adapter/init.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: At most one selected backend region and full adapter comparison.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Leaf-only win or Numba B matches it; reject C.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Platform and wheel maintenance must repay measured benefit.

candidates.title: Architecture-specific schedules behind portable contract
candidates.transformation: Tune x86/ARM or device schedules separately behind capability-detected internal kernels; retain semantic reference.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Platform eligibility and strict math versioned; public API unmodified.
candidates.cost_model: Different schedules may improve locality/lanes; no cross-hardware speed multiplication.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Named hardware only; no claims for untested OS/ISA.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Additional dependency/packaging complexity not justified.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: CPU-only core must import without all accelerator extras.

candidates.title: Multi-accelerator independent job routing
candidates.transformation: Assign independent logical tiles to available CPU/GPU devices with capacity and transfer-aware queueing.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Exact output mapping, publication order, state isolation and hardware scope recorded.
candidates.cost_model: Makespan lower bound max(total capacity demand,critical chain,IO); measure shared host bottleneck.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Only if deployment actually needs multiple devices; small distinct jobs first.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: No such hardware/workload or disk/link saturated.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Explicit optional extension, not part of initial execution wave.

candidates.title: Band-wise angular operator precomputation
candidates.transformation: Factor real-valued sum by common band emissivity: H[x,b]=sum_{p in b}V[x,p]w[p]; then sum_b H[x,b]E[b,t].
candidates.proof_and_guard: Same real expression may differ in float32 rounding; cannot enter exact default.
candidates.cost_model: O(TNP) -> O(NP+TNBands) for eligible terms only.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Derive error bounds and profile old rejected angular moments before any separately authorized experiment.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: No authorization to change numerical evaluation; remain design-only.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Potential large arithmetic saving, no bitwise claim.

candidates.title: Matrix multiply or batched time contraction
candidates.transformation: Express truly linear forcing-dependent components as operator application; consider GEMM only outside state-dependent chronology.
candidates.proof_and_guard: BLAS reduction/FMA order differs; time-dependent state and nonlinear masks cannot be batched blindly.
candidates.cost_model: Higher arithmetic intensity/BLAS utilization at operator memory cost.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Symbolic dependency proof plus separately authorized numeric tolerance study.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Current exact contract or dynamic nonlinear dependencies block it.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Not default GPU tensor-core permission.

candidates.title: Convolution/prefix scan/horizon replacement
candidates.transformation: Investigate only where original discrete operator and padding can be represented exactly; FFT/continuous horizons are not automatic equivalents.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Prefix subtraction and reassociation alter rounding; oblique rays differ from translation recurrences.
candidates.cost_model: Potential asymptotic reduction, but semantics usually differ.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Proof before benchmark; retain original unsupported cases.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: No discrete equivalence proof or inherited failed approach repeated.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Existing rejected horizon experiments are required reading.

candidates.title: Mixed precision, fast math and approximations
candidates.transformation: Catalog float16/tensor cores/approximate trig/Horner opportunities only as a separate authorized numerical profile.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Never weaken exact tests, patch count, ray detail or physical components by default.
candidates.cost_model: May increase throughput but changes arithmetic contract.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Separate model policy and error study, never production adoption from this packet.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: No explicit user authorization.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Do not relabel approximate as exact after final-output tolerance passes.

candidates.title: Operational contract tradeoffs
candidates.transformation: Fewer checkpoints/outputs, source metadata trust, approximate caches or shorter model horizon are distinct product choices.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Clearly different workload, durability or validation semantics; not transparent speedups.
candidates.cost_model: Can reduce I/O/service, comparison denominator must change explicitly.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Separate authorized deployment profile only.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Default DX/numerical/durability contract unchanged.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Listed to prevent hidden shortcuts.

candidates.title: Hardware/power/affinity changes
candidates.transformation: Record plugged-in power, thermal state, ISA, affinity and storage as experimental factors.
candidates.proof_and_guard: Faster hardware or extra cores is not a same-budget code speedup. Do not alter user power policy automatically.
candidates.cost_model: Changes effective resource capacity rather than same-work algorithm.
candidates.small_deciding_experiment: Compare within matched hardware/power cells; report resource deltas separately.
candidates.reject_or_defer_when: Uncontrolled conditions invalidate affected performance comparisons.
candidates.overlap_or_dependency: Battery/AC min-time ratios are not general performance guarantees.
